name: table_in_newton_block
source:
{ A TABLE lookup inside an ordinary solve chain: the interpolant is just another
  function in the residual. Java CodeTableTest.tableFunctionParticipatesInNewtonSolve:
  Q = 80 * 2.5 = 200. }
TABLE htc(re)
  1000   50
  2000   80
  4000   120
END
Re = 2000
A = 2.5
U = htc(Re)
Q = U * A
